subject.title: fix(cli): bound media input file reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Should capability-CLI preserve acceptance of currently unbounded `--file` inputs, or should OpenClaw intentionally introduce the proposed 100 MiB per-file and 500 MiB aggregate rejection contract?
rationale: The prior implementation accepted files without these fixed thresholds, so choosing them is a user-visible compatibility policy rather than a mechanical TOCTOU repair.

options.title: Confirm and document bounded inputs
options.body: Adopt explicit supported size limits, make the descriptor read bounded to the validated byte count, add focused compatibility coverage, and document the new CLI rejection behavior.

options.title: Preserve existing input acceptance
options.body: Keep the existing acceptance contract and pursue a TOCTOU/resource-safety design that does not add unconditional new size rejections.

recommendation.title: Confirm and document bounded inputs
recommendation.body: Adopt explicit supported size limits, make the descriptor read bounded to the validated byte count, add focused compatibility coverage, and document the new CLI rejection behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main CLI ownership history was not available in the supplied review evidence.
